Pinned Bevy engine patches

bevy_render, bevy_pbr, bevy_solari and bevy_light originate from crates.io Bevy 0.20.0-rc.2,
upstream tag commit 343a0233d6788a49f224a3684c8995e246663df3.
The MIT and Apache-2.0 licenses remain alongside each copied production source.
Only manifests, licenses, upstream README files and production src trees are
retained. Dependencies are excluded from the single-package workspace.
The root [patch.crates-io] selects these sources; Cargo.lock pins the entire
Bevy dependency graph to the same RC. Original assets remain untouched.

Original crates.io package SHA256 checksums:
bevy_render 85dec5029f3bd8ca09f584f24df77d1bd096906062aa4377bc8af95d60f50136
bevy_pbr 69a4a0e861abccd2ff8c655415ab3981f401a83b930a4c5c7227a0b6297f709e
bevy_solari d3b48f81a2d3fa80a171fdb8b2655182f2b272dd17da05776b31b875810eee91
bevy_light 0bc5b5af22aa7380852dcab45c71a77f6c94d98436e93e903e06c5fdf861cc77

Local changes:
bevy_light: local-light visibility retains bounded 16-meter spatial membership
for native casters. Native point/spot range, layer, visibility-range and frustum
checks receive deduplicated nearby candidates instead of scanning every caster
for each dirty light. Missing/invalid/large/forced-visible bounds remain global;
oversized light queries fall back to all native casters. Membership follows
current transforms/bounds and authoritative query retirement, independently of
camera visibility. Work counters default off. The upstream cluster test module
and test.rs are excluded; no test suite or fixture is added. Three upstream
light-cookie documentation lines have trailing Markdown spaces trimmed.
bevy_render: frame/workload-associated raw diagnostic records, bounded paired
query banks/readbacks, completed FIFO, earlier recording and coverage reporting.
bevy_pbr: stable per-shadow-view/face timing and invocation context; the native
vertex body is callable by extended materials through mesh_vertex, with the
original vertex entry point forwarding to it without changing its arithmetic;
incremental light extraction retains unchanged live shadow visibility tables
and retires hidden retained records/view owners from the authoritative inventory,
including lights whose cached visibility components are temporarily parked.
LightMeta retains point and directional/spot depth-array storage at bounded
high-water capacities; changing visible counts no longer accumulates exact-size
arrays in the three-frame transient texture cache. Resolution changes recreate
storage and existing texture-slot invalidation refreshes the affected maps.
Environment generation retains per-entity intermediate mip textures and all
filter bindings/uniforms/views/placeholders while source, output, intermediate,
blue-noise texture identities, sampler/layout resources and downsampling mode
remain compatible. Texture replacements and size/layout changes rebuild them.
RenderEnvironmentMap exposes an optional source revision for render-graph
producers. Completed downsampling/convolution revisions live with the retained
bindings; an unchanged source skips fresh copy/downsampling/filtering. Recreated
bindings invalidate those revisions. Filtering waits for the matching complete
six-face mip chain. Uncontrolled native callers preserve per-frame generation.
bevy_solari: the RC's retained incremental scene, sparse uploads, cached bindings
and native TLAS build are adopted intact; native BLAS/TLAS diagnostic spans are
retained. An extracted DynamicRaytracingMesh ECS marker selects fast-build,
non-compacting BLAS construction for posed providers; static meshes retain
fast-trace construction and one-time compaction. Replacing a stable mesh ID
retires its pending compaction job before constructing its new BLAS. Native
previous-TLAS retirement and submission-completion lifetimes remain intact.
This is safe rebuilding, not in-place refitting. The marker uses the matching
RC bevy_extract dependency. No obsolete whole-scene binder/extraction gates
are ported.

Upstream embedded binaries use Git LFS and remain byte-identical. Their working
files must be hydrated for native include_bytes! calls. Imported WESL trailing
ASCII spaces/tabs and excess EOF blanks may be normalized without changing tokens.
Package checksums identify upstream archives, not hashes of this patched tree.

Avian compatibility follows upstream PR 1070 at immutable revision
34c9b008d2f40638a953d9218db48d54f661365d, including its pinned Bevy-heavy,
transform-interpolation and matrix dependencies. It targets Bevy 0.20; root
exact RC constraints select rc.2 throughout. Existing f32 behavior is its default.
